method.rankBy: conditional mean minus same-asset same-cohort unconditional mean
method.multipleTesting: Holm across all supported asset/horizon/condition tests within each panel

panels.name: long

EQUITY.instrument: French broad US market: Mkt-RF + RF

TREASURY.instrument: Shiller reconstructed nominal bond index: real bond index × CPI
TREASURY.note: Publisher model based on monthly rates; not an observed IEF-equivalent index.

GOLD.instrument: World Bank monthly average USD gold; attributed public mirror

COMMODITIES.instrument: AQR equal-weight commodity futures excess return + French RF collateral
COMMODITIES.note: Research reconstruction; different universe/weights from GSCI and DBC.

sourceLimitations: Monthly proxy observations are not all executable month-end closes.
Revised economic states and reconstructed indices introduce hindsight bias.
Common sample stops at AQR cutoff; no splice extends it to 2026.
